result.reason: The redline appropriately and narrowly extends the licence to Client’s affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf, preserving the existing permitted-use scope. However, it does not address the required duration and transfer rights: paid-up licences are not made perpetual and irrevocable, subscription licences remain terminable under the general Section 12 standard rather than only for uncured material breach, and no transfer right to successors—including an M&A successor—is added. It therefore reaches only part of the preferred position and does not fully reach the fallback position.
